content: entgo.io/contrib is ONE multi-package Go module (go.mod at repo root) containing entgql, entoas, entproto, schemast as subpackages/subdirectories, versioned together (latest v0.7.0, Mar 2025), NOT stable v1.0. entcache is a SEPARATE module/repo entirely: ariga.io/entcache (github.com/ariga/entcache), independently versioned. Both patterns (bundled contrib module vs standalone module) are precedent in the ecosystem.
